product_one_liner.value: Leena AI provides an agentic AI platform with AI colleagues that automate back-office workflows and employee support for enterprise organizations across HR, IT, and Finance.
product_one_liner.notes: Homepage identifies its enterprise platform and pre-built AI colleagues for HR, IT, and Finance.

pricing_page.notes: A dedicated pricing page exists and describes licensing options with custom quotes.

named_customers.notes: Each is identified in Leena AI customer case study or webinar materials.

employee_band.notes: Published employee estimate is 368 in 2026, within the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: Dealroom lists New York City, United States as headquarters; company about page lists multiple offices but does not specify HQ.

founded_year.notes: Company about page says it was founded in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index includes technical architecture and engineering/data-pipeline material, including multiple posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site contains several product and integration guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board is accessible and lists openings, but the indexed current titles did not show a qualifying AI/ML/data-science role; AI/technical phrases in job descriptions do not satisfy the title-based criterion.

model_provider.notes: Available documentation, security/trust material, and blog search results did not establish a publicly stated provider used by the product. References to models in general discussions do not identify the product's provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Listed certifications/claims requested by the task; other listed controls and privacy regulations were omitted because they are not among the requested categories.

last_funding.notes: IBM Ventures announced a strategic investment in October 2026. Public announcement does not disclose the amount, so amount_usd is set to 0 rather than guessing. Prior disclosed round was $30 million Series B in September 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: The strategic investment announcement on 2026-10-20 falls within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job listings include Enterprise Sales Development Representative roles.

launched_6mo.notes: The Group Chat Agent for Slack launch is dated July 10, 2026, inside the six-month window; Leena AI Forge was also announced in October 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available team page identifies current leaders but does not provide start dates, and no adequately supported dated join/departure announcement was found for the period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Public product documentation has specific connector guides for both systems.
